limits: Keep finite and undirected conditions; this is a degree-counting lemma rather than an edge-traversal criterion.

proposals.label: Brown dwarf
proposals.learning_takeaway: Brown dwarfs form from collapsing gas but lack enough mass to sustain hydrogen fusion in their cores.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.support_note: The NASA article states both formation and the fusion distinction.

proposed_parent.note: The source describes a class of celestial objects.

limits: Qualify hydrogen fusion; do not claim brown dwarfs cannot undergo any nuclear fusion.

proposals.label: Mars
proposals.learning_takeaway: Mars looks red because iron minerals in its surface material oxidize, much as iron rusts.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.support_note: NASA directly connects oxidation of minerals with the planet’s appearance.

proposed_parent.note: The source explains a physical property of a particular planet.

proposals.label: Betelgeuse
proposals.learning_takeaway: Betelgeuse’s 2019 outburst ejected material that cooled into dust and temporarily blocked some of the star’s light.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.support_note: NASA describes a historical observed event and its dust-obscuration mechanism.

proposed_parent.note: The source analyzes observations of a particular red-supergiant star.

limits: The exact triggering mechanism remains uncertain; do not predict an imminent supernova.

proposals.label: Resonance
proposals.learning_takeaway: Resonance favors particular oscillation frequencies; radio tuners adjust a circuit’s capacitance or inductance to select a station.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.support_note: The textbook connects periodic energy input, large amplitude and dissipation.

discovery_evidence.locator: Electrical/mechanical analogy, lines 36-47; radio tuning, lines 75-76
discovery_evidence.support_note: The text links electrical and mechanical resonance, then explains frequency-selective radio tuning.

proposed_parent.note: Both treatments explicitly describe resonant responses of driven oscillating systems.

limits: Retain resonance across systems; the electrical-tuning example differs from existing mechanical and sympathetic resonance cards. Do not restrict the broad identity to circuits.

proposals.label: Gravitational lens
proposals.learning_takeaway: A massive foreground object curves spacetime, bending background light into distorted or magnified images.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.locator: Spacetime curvature, lines 296-297; image distortion, lines 335-339
discovery_evidence.support_note: NASA connects mass, curved light paths and observable image changes.

proposed_parent.note: The source explicitly explains the effect through general relativity.

limits: Image form depends on alignment; multiple images are not universal.

proposals.label: Synchrotron radiation
proposals.learning_takeaway: High-energy electrons emit synchrotron radiation when magnetic fields bend their paths; facilities direct this light into experimental beamlines.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.locator: Definition, lines 78-80; storage ring and bending magnets, lines 87-89
discovery_evidence.support_note: ESRF links electron deflection, emitted radiation and beamline delivery.

proposed_parent.note: The storage-ring explanation explicitly identifies synchrotron radiation as electromagnetic radiation.

limits: Use the electron-storage-ring example; do not claim all synchrotron radiation requires a laboratory or that electrons reach vacuum light speed.

proposals.label: Andromeda Galaxy
proposals.learning_takeaway: Absorption of background quasar light revealed the diffuse gaseous halo surrounding the Andromeda Galaxy.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.support_note: The observed absorption supplies a mechanism for mapping nearly invisible gas.

proposed_parent.note: The study uses astronomical observations to investigate a named galaxy.

limits: Keep the gaseous halo distinct from the visible stellar disk; omit outdated collision-timing predictions.

proposals.label: Refraction
proposals.learning_takeaway: Light crossing between materials can change direction as its speed changes, with the bend also depending on incidence angle.
proposals.identity_reason: Eligible canonical ID; intended meaning agrees with the frozen source record and the inspected educational treatment.

discovery_evidence.locator: Direction, speed and Snell’s law, lines 34-45
discovery_evidence.support_note: The source relates speed contrast and incident angle to the refracted direction.

proposed_parent.note: The passage studies how light travels across a material interface.

limits: At normal incidence speed may change without a directional bend.
